description: List the patents in which a compound was found (SureChEMBL). Accepts the same identifier forms as surechembl_compound. Aspirin is in ~700,000 documents, so read the total and narrow with surechembl_search_patents when it is large.

identifier.description: A SureChEMBL id ("SCHEMBL1353" or "1353"), a ChEMBL id ("CHEMBL25"), a PubChem CID as "pubchem:2244", a DrugBank id as "drugbank:DB00945", a standard InChIKey, a SMILES, or a chemical name ("aspirin"; resolved through PubChem to a structure, since SureChEMBL has no name lookup).

name: surechembl_patents_for_compound
title: Patents mentioning a compound
